objective: Prove that the least record width with which the w-record law decides or counts a not-all-equal pattern is its treewidth plus one (bucket elimination), connect the seam and braid findings, and state the known escapes (affine records, Pfaffians); label known parts.
status: Proved 2026-11-16 (refereed JOINT-RECORDS-R1, confirmed): the w-record law is tree-decomposition dynamic programming, least w = treewidth + 1 (known); NAE seam reports = complement-closed relations (2, 4, 16, 256), each realized (referee); two-place shadows determine all at s <= 2 and 12 of 16 at s = 3, the 4 failures being NAE and its single-flip variants (knots); s = 4: 50 and 226 of 256 (computed).
title: The w-record law is width-based dynamic programming
